name: single-shot-game-generation
description: End-to-end generator for a complete, playable, visually beautiful game built in ONE orchestrated multi-agent workflow. The orchestrator writes an immutable contract + an art-direction style bible, fans the build out across parallel sonnet implementers (with dedicated world/structure/character/fx/lighting art agents), runs a review → adversarial-verify → fix gauntlet, then actually runs the game, captures screenshots, and iterates against an art-director judge until it looks great. Stack-agnostic; browser/canvas games are the sweet spot. Companion to contract-first-prep (which stops at the blueprint).
